execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."creditTransaction" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "balanceAfter" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "usageEventId" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."creditWallet" (
  "balance" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "functionCallName" text,
  "functionCallResponse" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "text" text,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "amountMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credits" int4,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "planId" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerOrderId" text,
  "providerPaymentId" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."plan" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "interval" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "monthlyCredits" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentPeriodEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerCustomerId" text,
  "providerSubscriptionId" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."usageEvent" (
  "cachedInputTokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditsCharged" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inputTokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "messageId" text,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "outputTokens" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "googleId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhookEvent" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "payload" json NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerEventId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."website" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "templateName" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
